'''''Historia Galactica'' Volume Seventy: ''Iaco Stark to the Clone Wars''''' was an historical record of the period leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was written by [[Wottlet Scarsir]] and discussed the increasing power of merchants during that time.
